record_type: Normalized production specifications; exact dash prompts are recorded separately in JAKA_DASH_ASSET_PROMPTS.json.
common: Crisp detailed 2D pixel art matching the reference, same character identity, clothes, body proportions and palette in every frame. Side-view platformer sprite, FACE RIGHT throughout. Use a strict evenly spaced grid of square cells, fixed camera and scale, whole body and weapon fully inside every cell, consistent grounded baseline at 88 percent of each cell height. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no black/brown backdrop, no checkerboard, no frame numbers, grid lines, labels, ground plane or extra characters. No gore.

assets.brief: Six jump frames: anticipation, rise, tuck, apex, descend, landing. Same root position and scale; no double jump, new physics or dash.

assets.brief: Row 1 six stance break frames ending in stable kneeling, reversed for standing. Row 2 six non-graphic defeat frames ending lying unconscious. Keep exact clothing, identity and palette.

assets.brief: Six stance break frames from standing through stumble to one-knee kneel in frame 6. Hold last pose four seconds then reverse in gameplay. Output faces left and is flipped during deterministic preparation to match right-facing runtime base.

preparation: tools/combat_art.gd cuts equal cells, thresholds alpha >= 0.5, uses a fixed scale per sheet and aligns feet. Raw images are preserved and excluded from export.
